intro: Defias bandits now hold Mirror Lake Orchard, on Mirror Lake's southern shore in western Elwynn Forest. The quiet homestead near Thunder Falls has fallen to outlaws while Stormwind's guards are stretched thin.

p: Mirror Lake Orchard once fed a peaceful farmstead with the clean waters of Mirror Lake. Now Defias Brotherhood bandits have seized the cottage and grounds near Thunder Falls. With Stormwind's military stretched thin and King Varian Wrynn missing, rural homes across Elwynn are easy targets for outlaws seeking shelter.
